title: evidence.claim.v1
description: One physical evidence directory per claim. NO claim is reported without this file. Empty commands or empty assertions is structurally invalid; scripts/validate.py cross-checks that every assertions[].evidence_quote appears verbatim in commands[].stdout_excerpt or in a referenced artifact file. (See inline comments on lines 5 and 209 below for context on the SkillSpector false positives this schema has triggered.)

claim.description: The exact sentence that will appear in the final report. Mirror it verbatim in the four-line proof block.

slug.description: Kebab-case label matching the directory name.

preconditions.description: What was true before this claim became testable. Non-empty.

commands.description: REAL executed commands. Empty array fails validation.

exit_code.description: Real exit code of the command THIS turn.

stdout_excerpt.description: Trimmed but lossless around the assertion line.

assertions.description: Each assertion name MUST map to a literal line in commands[].stdout_excerpt or in a sibling artifact. The runtime cross-check (scripts/validate.py) verifies the evidence_quote appears verbatim in at least one such source; an empty or fabricated quote is rejected.

evidence_quote.description: Exact line from output that made you mark it passed/failed. Cross-checked at runtime against commands[*].stdout_excerpt / stderr_excerpt and referenced artifact files.

artifacts.description: For browser: MUST include ≥ 1 screenshot/trace AND ≥ 1 log. For db-migration: MUST include ≥ 1 log with non-empty content_excerpt. Per-environment constraints live under allOf.

content_excerpt.description: For kind=log artifacts, the runtime-relevant excerpt that proves the claim (e.g. the post-migration \d dump). When present, the runtime cross-check uses this AND the on-disk file.

remaining_gaps.description: Honest, non-decorative list of what is NOT yet proven.

allOf.description: Browser claims MUST include (1) a screenshot/trace/e2e-evidence artifact AND (2) a log artifact for the captured console. The log artifact is required even if it is empty — its presence means the agent captured it; the runtime cross-check verifies it is empty (zero console errors).
Browser claims require a log artifact (console capture).

Browser claims with WebSocket / SSE / long-poll should also reference a network artifact. The schema does not require it (cannot infer protocol from target_environment alone); the runtime cross-check warns if a browser claim has no `network` kind AND uses verification_method=browser-automation.

DB-migration claims MUST include a log artifact with a content_excerpt that contains a post-migration schema dump marker (Column | Table | ---). The runtime cross-check (scripts/validate.py) opens the log file and verifies the excerpt is not just a stub.

Static-analysis claims MUST have ≥ 1 assertion whose evidence_quote is a literal line from a real tool run. The strict anti-fabrication regex is enforced at runtime by scripts/validate.py (the schema pattern here is a permissive placeholder to keep the JSON Schema well-formed).
